title: ATM Helper
scenario: A stranger offers to help at an overseas ATM and says the machine is broken.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.C: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: ATM Helper: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Decline help and protect your card and PIN.
